desc:
Welcome aboard  Cabin Chaos Airlines: the world's worst airline. You're the crew. ✈️

Team up to check in passengers, load the cargo, fuel up and take off. Fly the full route and try to get everyone there in one piece.

🧪 CABIN CHAOS IS CURRENTLY IN BETA!
⚠️ Expect bugs, unfinished features, and plenty of updates as we keep improving

R — Ragdoll Character

⚡ Intense events requiring an expert crew to fix the plane mid-flight!
🍔 Serve meals, calm nervous flyers, catch seat thieves and rescue whoever got locked in the toilet.
🏝️ Island side quests: blast open the desert mine and thaw the glacier wreck for treasure.
💥 Ragdolls, slaps and very bumpy landings. 
🪽 Earn Wing Bucks and climb the ranks from Cadet to Sky Legend.
🕺 Unlock emotes and skins 

Hit Quick Play or make a lobby with friends.
👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates!
